subject: Harriet Tubman
description:
A carte-de-visite of a young Harriet Tubman seated in an interior room. Photographed by Benjamin F. Powelson in 1868-69. 
Originally owned by Emily Howland , an abolitionist Quaker schoolteacher who lived in Sherwood NY , just a few miles from where Tubman lived in Auburn, NY , the town where the image was taken. Jointly purchased by the National Museum of African American History and Culture  and the Library of Congress in 2017.
